title: Zephaniah
author: Zephaniah son of Cushi.
date: Late seventh century B.C., during Josiah's reign.
historicalSetting: Zephaniah warns of the day of the Lord and promises purified worship and restoration.
keyVerse: Zephaniah 3:17 — "Yahweh, your God, is among you, a mighty one who will save."
christFocus: Zephaniah points to Christ as the saving King in the midst of His people, bringing purification, joy, and restoration.
